name: Danganronpa DELUSION Jaehaeseokdoen Jeolmang-gwa Huimang-ui Choejeonseon
original_name: 단간론파 DELUSION 재해석된 절망과 희망의 최전선
source:
Life goes on, and nothing can be reversed.
An encounter is only a moment, but integrating does not make you a connection.
But... but if there's still meaning in that life, 
I think that's because life is proved by death.
